title: Average Revenue per Sale
scenario: Find the average revenue generated per transaction (sale_id) for each product. Return 'product_id' and 'avg_sale_revenue'.
tableSchema: sales (sale_id INT, product_id INT, year INT, quantity INT, price INT)
hint: Calculate (quantity * price) per row, then group by product_id.
correctQuery: SELECT product_id, AVG((quantity * price)::NUMERIC) AS avg_sale_revenue FROM sales GROUP BY product_id;
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE sales (sale_id INT, product_id INT, year INT, quantity INT, price INT); INSERT INTO sales VALUES (1, 100, 2008, 10, 5000), (2, 100, 2008, 2, 5000);
